product_metadata.title: Home-Man Gap Storage Narrow Home Organizer Rack Slim Home Garden Storage Rack Kitchen Bathroom Cart Tower Flower Pot Holder with Wheels (5 Tier)
features: CREATE ADDITIONAL STORAGE SPACE EASILY – This 5-tiered narrow mobile shelving unit organizer can be used ANYWHERE. The slim storage rack’s 5.9” design can fit an almost any narrow space. Ideal for closets, kitchens, bathrooms, garages, laundry rooms in homes, apartments and even offices. Create additional storage space for your home.

STORAGE SOLUTION FOR SLIM THIN NARROW SPACES – Make life more simple and less cluttered with this convenient slide out shelving unit. Great for canned food, spices, laundry supplies, pet supplies, home and bath cleaning supplies, and even kid’s toys. Perfect for the tiny space between your fridge and wall, or between your desk and wall, in closet, laundry room, nursery, corners, restrooms, bedrooms, washrooms, pantry, garage or under stairs, beside a table or wherever else you need some shelves.

STURDY AND DURABLE – Many customers want a slim gap organizer to storage more stuffs and fit their gap space perfectly, but a lot of them may complaint for the stability for some slim shelf. After long time of design and testing, finally we found the 5.9” is a perfect width, plus we use high quality raw material, make this shelf slim but sturdy and durable, no rust and mold.

EASY TO MOVE and ASSEMBLE – Four wheels attached to the base of the slide out pantry storage rack making it easy and convenient to pull in and out of narrow spaces. Excellent to put in-between your washer and dryer. Easy to assemble, it doesn't need to be installed with any tools, use a screwdriver to push the buckle out when removing it.

PRODUCT DETAILS - White, 17” L× 5.9” W× 46.5” H, 5.6lbs, the gap between the first and second layers is 13 inches, the other two gaps both 8.7 inches, it doesn't need to be installed with any tools, use a screwdriver to push the buckle out when removing it.
